[[File:ZygerrianBrothers.png|thumb|left|150px|Mard (left), with his brother Jorec]]
'''Mard Gemen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] who was the brother of [[Jorec Gemen]]. The two served as a [[Royal archivist]] during the tenure of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]]. When [[Atai Molec/Legends|Atai Molec]] became the new [[King/Legends|King]], Jorec and his brother were ordered to serve Molec's son, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]]. Mard and Jorec were extremely unsatisfied with such change.
